messages:
Maya Chen: ACME (enterprise) asked for a 'deferred customer pin' flow — they want new model versions to be available to them only after a delay (30–90d) and to guarantee pinned versions won't be auto-deprecated. Asking product+eng: feasible? launch criteria? quick sync?
Samir Gupta: technically doable. We can add a per-customer pin flag in the catalog service and an exception list for lifecycle automation. Main costs: catalog state complexity, migration path, test coverage. Roughly 2 sprints to land a safe rollout + migration script (prototype + QA).
Eli Rosen: From eval side we need preserved benchmark snapshots for any pinned version and a gated regression check. Proposal: add `pinned_benchmark_id` + `pinned_for_customers` to model metadata; retention policy for snapshots is important (defaults and overrides).
Zoe Park: ACME is willing to pay an SLA for the pinned lane and wants rollback support. They explicitly do NOT want canary surprises — they want isolation from staged rollouts.
Maya Chen: Draft launch criteria suggestion:
  1) API + Console UI to create a per-customer pin
  2) Benchmark snapshot retention (proposal: 180d default)
  3) Manual deprecation override for pinned models (no auto-sunset)
  4) E2E test coverage + migration/playbook for customer migrations
Any objections or missing items?
Samir Gupta: Add telemetry/alerts: detect drift vs pinned baseline and surface to CS. Also need storage-cost calc for snapshot retention and perms for who can set pins. Prototype internal first before exposing to customers.
Maya Chen: Good calls. Action items: @Eli draft minimal schema change, @Samir give eng estimate + risk notes, @Zoe confirm ACME billing/rollback ask. I'll own product acceptance criteria and playbook outline.
CatalogBot: deploy scheduled: catalog-schema-migration -> staging @ 2026-06-15T04:00Z
Eli Rosen: Will open a PR today with a sketch: ```
{
  "pinned_for_customers": ["acct-ACME-123"],
  "pinned_benchmark_id": "bench-2026-05-01-acme",
  "pin_created_by": "Zoe Park",
  "pin_ttl_days": null
}
``` Will include migration notes for existing models.
Zoe Park: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with ACME and ask for formal SLA text + rollback windows. Will update thread with customer expectations.
Maya Chen: Thanks — planning to slot this into Q3 initiative list if estimates look sane. Short sync tomorrow at 10am to align.
